title: The return fares

memory.witnessed: Phil uses the paid ticket and rides the coach all the way to Pittsburgh..
You reached your sister from the terminal payphone. She confirmed the van booking for Wednesday.
memory.your_words: Hey, it's Phil. I'm in Pittsburgh now, just off the coach. Listen, about tomorrow—van's booked for the couch, right? I want to nail down the pickup time and make sure I know which hallway we're dragging it through. I'll be at your place by noon, tops.

memory.witnessed: After that evening in Pittsburgh you woke back in your hotel bed. The radio again announced Tuesday, February 2.

clock: Closed Tuesday. An outside receipt may survive. Wednesday is only an alternative reducer rule and is never filmed in this cut.

shots.full_words_field: Rita. I hear you. About Alma. I'll call her from the terminal tomorrow, after I'm off the coach. I'll ask her what she wants to hear. I'll just... listen. I'll do it from a payphone with a three-minute limit and I'll do it. Goodnight.
